annotations.title: What exchange rates did to it

description:
For a portfolio held in one currency but priced partly in others: how much is outside the
        base currency, and what exchange rates added to growth, volatility and the worst
        fall, against the same holdings currency-hedged. Typical questions: 'I'm in euros
        but hold US funds: what did the dollar do to me?'; 'How much currency risk is in
        this?'; 'Hedged or not, what was the difference?'. Limits: Only when some holdings
        are priced in another currency than the holder's. base must be set to the holder's
        currency. It does not recommend, predict or calculate tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

name: currency_effect

outputSchema.description: What exchange rates did to the portfolio, seen from the base currency.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

by_currency.description: [currency, share of the money] pairs, by listing currency.

cagr_from_currency.description: Growth per year added (or removed) by exchange rates.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

foreign_share.description: Share of the money priced outside the base currency.

hedged.description: The same with the currency moves removed.

limitations.description: What this cannot show (listing currency is not earning currency).

share_of_vol.description: Share of the volatility that comes from exchange rates.

unhedged.description: Growth, volatility and worst fall as held.

title: What exchange rates did to it
